title: DART: A DAG-Based Reputation and Incentive Framework via Blockchain-Enabled Governance for Trustworthy LLM Multi-Agent Collaboration
abstract: arXiv:2609.05529v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) predominantly rely on centralized orchestration and lack formal verification mechanisms for agent reliability, participation, and system-level behavioral alignment. These shortcomings leave open environments severely vulnerable to uncooperative or malicious agents. This work proposes DART, a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG)-based reputation and incentive regulation framework for trustworthy multi-agent collaboration, combining centralized operational orchestration with blockchain-enabled decentralized governance and accountability. DART unifies DAG workflow orchestration, capability and reputation-aware task allocation, dynamic behavior updates, multi-factor incentives, and smart contract accountability paired with IPFS storage. translated_title: DART：一种基于DAG的声誉与激励框架，通过区块链赋能治理实现可信的LLM多智能体协作
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）主要依赖集中式编排，缺乏针对智能体可靠性、参与度以及系统级行为一致性的形式化验证机制。这些缺陷使开放环境极易受到不合作或恶意智能体的威胁。本工作提出了DART，一个基于有向无环图（DAG）的声誉与激励监管框架，用于实现可信的多智能体协作，它将集中式操作编排与区块链赋能的去中心化治理和问责机制相结合。DART统一了DAG工作流编排、能力与声誉感知的任务分配、动态行为更新、多因素激励，以及与IPFS存储配对的智能合约问责机制。在这一范式下，智能体选择动态平衡任务对齐度、历史声誉和工作负载，而执行后的行为证据...
tldr: DART框架将集中式操作编排与区块链赋能的去中心化治理相结合，通过基于DAG的声誉与激励机制实现可信的LLM多智能体协作。
en_tdlr: DART combines centralized operational orchestration with blockchain-enabled decentralized governance to achieve trustworthy LLM multi-agent collaboration through a DAG-based reputation and incentive framework.
